name: Jinno Nahoko
source:
Hobbies: Reading
Likes: Milkshakes, chocolate chip cookies
Plane: Ki-46 III Otsu + Hei

A third-year. A girl blessed with both intelligence and beauty, and is the current student council president of Shouou Academy.
Always seems to be just a little bored, and sometimes will do strange things to scare the living daylights out of everyone around her.
Starts making plans to form a Fairy Fight team once Junichi and the other new residents arrive at the dorm.
